atoms.name: Series operations
atoms.one_line: Substitute, multiply, differentiate or integrate termwise.

atoms.name: Limits by series
atoms.one_line: Expand, cancel low-order terms, read the first survivor.

atoms.name: Polynomial approximation
atoms.one_line: Truncate at degree $n$; higher $n$ means smaller error.

atoms.name: Summing series and convergence
atoms.one_line: Recognise $e^x$, $\sin$, $\cos$ or geometric sums; radius of convergence.

atoms.name: First non-zero term and extrema
atoms.one_line: Lowest surviving power decides max, min or neither.
